name: slide-forge
description: Agent-first slide generation skill: turns a host Agent's structured scenes.json into a 1920×1080 deck (HTML / PDF / video) using 13 themes and 22+ content variants. Zero LLM dependency — the host Agent reads sources and writes scenes.json itself; SlideForge only renders.
author: heytea

scripts.demo:html-local: rm -rf demo_html_out && mkdir -p demo_html_out && cp examples/scenes_example.json demo_html_out/scenes.json && echo '{"command":"render","scenes":"./demo_html_out/scenes.json","output_dir":"./demo_html_out","format":["html"]}' | node executor.js
scripts.demo:tencent-html-local: rm -rf tencent_html_demo && mkdir -p tencent_html_demo && cp examples/tencent_intro_scenes_fixture.json tencent_html_demo/scenes.json && echo '{"command":"render","scenes":"./tencent_html_demo/scenes.json","output_dir":"./tencent_html_demo","design_mode":"neon-cyber","format":["html"]}' | node executor.js
scripts.test:tencent-html: rm -rf test_tencent_html && mkdir -p test_tencent_html && cp examples/tencent_intro_scenes_fixture.json test_tencent_html/scenes.json && echo '{"command":"render","scenes":"./test_tencent_html/scenes.json","output_dir":"./test_tencent_html","design_mode":"neon-cyber","format":["html"]}' | node executor.js
scripts.test:e2e: rm -rf test_e2e && mkdir -p test_e2e && cp examples/four_new_variants_scenes.json test_e2e/scenes.json && echo '{"command":"render","scenes":"./test_e2e/scenes.json","output_dir":"./test_e2e","format":["pdf","html"]}' | node executor.js
scripts.clean: rm -rf output output_* pipeline_run_output release_smoke_* skill_walkthrough v4_* test_* demo_html_out tencent_html_demo verify_notebook_shell preview_four_variants debug_html preview project
